2024-maxi-1|A|Equations & systems|Two walkers start at sunrise from opposite ends $X,Y$ of the same path and walk toward each other at constant speeds. They meet at noon. The walker starting at $X$ reaches $Y$ at 16:00, and the other reaches $X$ at 21:00. When was sunrise?

2024-maxi-2|N|Modular arithmetic|Is the cube of a sum of integers minus the sum of their cubes always divisible by $3$? Prove your answer first for two integers, then for three, and then for any number $n$ of integers.

2024-maxi-4|N|Digits & bases,Algebraic identities|For an integer $n\ge10$, let $S(n)$ be its decimal digit sum and $T(n)$ the sum of all positive-length proper prefixes of its decimal representation. For example, $T(2345)=234+23+2$. Prove that $(n-S(n))/T(n)$ is an integer independent of $n$.

2022-midi-1|G|Angle chasing,Similarity & congruence|Triangle $ABC$ has longest side $AC$. Points $D,E$ on $AC$ satisfy $AD=AB$ and $CE=CB$. Find $\angle EBD$ (a) when $A=60^\circ,C=20^\circ$; (b) in terms of angle $B$ generally.

2022-midi-3|G|Coordinates & vectors,Area & dissection|Six equal squares are arranged as follows: four share full edges in a row; one is attached above the second square, and one below the fourth. Rotate this assembly so that the row slopes upward at an angle strictly between $0^\circ$ and $45^\circ$. Its tight horizontal bounding rectangle has width $12$ and height $7$, with the lower-left corner of the first square on the bottom edge and the upper-right corner of the square above the row on the top edge, as in the diagram. Find the area of one square.\n\n![The six-square arrangement inside its bounding rectangle](assets/range-restoration/belgium-2022-midi-3.png)

2022-midi-4|C|Extremal arguments,Counting|Athletes numbered $1$ through $100$ stand in that order. After some are disqualified, the remaining $n$ athletes move left without passing one another to occupy positions $1$ through $n$. If every remaining athlete moves a different number of positions, what is the least possible number disqualified?

2023-midi-1|N|Digits & bases,Squares & powers|Two sisters have two-digit ages. Concatenating their ages in a fixed order gives a perfect square. In $23$ years both ages will still have two digits, and concatenating them in the same order will again give a square. Find their current ages.

2024-midi-2|A|Invariants,Equations & systems|Transfer one spoonful of syrup from a large bottle into a smaller glass of water, mix thoroughly, then transfer the same volume of mixture back to the bottle. 2024-midi-3|G|Circles & tangency,Coordinates & vectors|A circle of radius $12$ contains two equal circles of radius $a$, tangent to one another at its centre and internally tangent to it. A circle of radius $b$ is internally tangent to the large circle and externally tangent to both smaller circles. A further circle of radius $c$ is internally tangent to the large circle, externally tangent to one radius-$a$ circle, and tangent to the common tangent diameter of the two equal circles, lying between that diameter and the chosen radius-$a$ circle on the same side of the centre. Find $a,b,c$.

2024-midi-4|N|Valuations|For a positive integer $n$, let $P(n)$ be the exponent of the largest power of $2$ dividing $n$. Find (a) $P(336)$; (b) $P(ab)$ in terms of $P(a),P(b)$; (c) $P(10!)$; (d) $P(100!)$.
